description: This file manages theme settings for a web application, including theme application, theme change listeners, and theme state management using React hooks.

methods.name: applyTheme
methods.description: Initializes and applies the theme based on user preferences and system settings.

methods.name: addThemeListener
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked when the theme changes.

methods.name: removeThemeListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered theme change callback.

methods.name: currentTheme
methods.description: Retrieves the current theme setting from persistent storage.

methods.name: currentDocumentTheme
methods.description: Returns the current theme applied to the document, if any.

methods.name: useThemeSetting
methods.description: React hook that provides the current theme and a setter function.
